hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the shared symbolic template f(x)*K(x)*f(x) by replacing the function parameter f with V or W, the kernel parameter K with G0 or H0, and the variable parameter x with p or q. This yields each three-factor product exactly.
required_assumptions: The symbols V, W, G0, H0 are uninterpreted functions applied to the respective variables p and q.
proof_obligations: Verify V(p)*G0(p)*V(p) equals f(x)*K(x)*f(x) under f=V, K=G0, x=p
Verify W(q)*H0(q)*W(q) equals f(x)*K(x)*f(x) under f=W, K=H0, x=q
hypotheses.rationale: Both non-identical terms have the same three-factor product structure: an outer function applied twice around a central kernel function, differing only by the function names and variable names.
